title: Excluded Causes and Commercial-Use Settings of the Brake Service Warranties Lines
content:
## Excluded causes

Each line of Brake Service Warranties lists the causes that void warranty coverage of a visit:

| Brake service line | Causes that void warranty coverage of a visit |
|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | collision; contamination by a fluid leak; a seized caliper that was not serviced; racing; impact damage |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | collision; contamination by a fluid leak; racing; impact damage |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | collision; contamination by a fluid leak; racing; impact damage |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | collision; contamination by a fluid leak; racing; impact damage |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | collision; contamination by a fluid leak; racing; impact damage |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | collision; contamination by a fluid leak; impact damage |

Differences between the lists: a seized caliper that was not serviced is listed only on the Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty; racing is listed on every line except the Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty; collision, contamination by a fluid leak and impact damage are listed on all six lines.

## Commercial use and fleet charging

| Brake service line | Warranty applies on a vehicle in commercial use | Fleet brakes discount applies when the job is charged to a Crestline Fleet Account |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | Yes | Yes |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | No | No |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | No | No |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | Yes | Yes |

- *Warranty applies on a vehicle in commercial use* — whether the line's warranty applies when the vehicle is in commercial use.
- *Fleet brakes discount* — whether the brakes discount of a Crestline Fleet Account applies when the brake job is charged to that fleet account.

The two lifetime lines, the Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty and the Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty, read "No" in both columns; the other four lines read "Yes" in both.
